evidence.quote: We use BioLinkBERT (Yasunaga et al., 2022) as the backbone LLM since it is specifically trained on the biomedical corpuses.

decisions.rationale: R3: BioLinkBERT is a named pretrained LLM.

evidence.quote: We use learnable d dimensional embeddings to represent each class, f cls ( c ) = h c .

decisions.rationale: R3: embedding representations for class identifiers use lookup with a learnable embedding resource.

parameters.name: order
parameters.value: source modality X source followed by target modality X target

decisions.chain_element: concatenation of measures of source modality X source and target modality X target

evidence.quote: let X = [ X source , X target ] be the concatenation of measures of source modality X source ∈ R n,m s and target modality X target ∈ R n,m t

decisions.rationale: R6: the source explicitly states concatenation and gives the source-then-target order.

decisions.chain_element: estimate expression levels of target modality from the input modality

evidence.quote: Modality prediction aims to estimate expression levels of target modality from the input modality.

decisions.rationale: R1: this element states the task performed by the model.

evidence.quote: a graph neural network (GNN) on a gene similarity graph G

decisions.rationale: R0: this element names the graph data object used as input.

evidence.quote: The gene perturbation embeddings are then computed using simple graph convolution (SGC) (Wu et al., 2019), f GEARS ( c ) = SGC ( c , G ) .

decisions.rationale: R7: graph convolution is an explicit computation without a corresponding catalog primitive.

evidence.quote: We use a linear mapping W ∈ R m × d to project the noised gene expression x t ∈ R m into R d

decisions.rationale: R3: a named linear mapping is represented by a project call.

evidence.quote: and further mix it with the sinusoidal time embedding (Appendix B.1) to inject diffusion time step information

decisions.rationale: R3: sinusoidal time embedding is a positional/time encoding inside the model.

evidence.quote: We follow Lopez et al. (2018) and mix in an additional learnable batch embedding with the latent embedding according to the batch label of the input cell.

decisions.rationale: R3: a named learnable embedding indexed by batch label uses lookup with a learnable table.

decisions.chain_element: use annotated scRNA-seq data as a reference

evidence.quote: This task typically requires some external reference, in most cases using annotated scRNA-seq data as a reference

decisions.rationale: R1: this element describes the external reference source and its provenance.

decisions.chain_element: estimate the proportions of different cell types

evidence.quote: Cell type deconvolution is to estimate the proportions of different cell types within mixed-cell spatial transcriptomics data.

decisions.rationale: R1: this element states the downstream task performed by the model.

evidence.quote: We process the context condition similarly as the input embedding using a linear projection, but without the time embedding: f ctxt (˜ x ) = ˜ xW ctxt .

decisions.rationale: R3: a named linear projection is represented by a project call.

operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The paper explicitly applies graph convolution/message passing on a gene similarity graph, while the catalog has no graph-convolution or message-passing primitive.
